shell.nothingSaved: No account. Only your language choice is kept, in this browser.
shell.footerNoScores: No tests. No scores. Nothing about you or your students is saved.
shell.footerChecked: Every answer is checked by a computer algebra system.

home.title: Feel sure of the math before you teach it.
home.intro: Pick tomorrow’s topic. See why each step works, what students usually get wrong, and what to say when they do.
home.topicsIntro: Each topic: the idea, worked examples, common mistakes and a lesson outline.
home.prepareText: Refresh the idea and see every step explained three ways.
home.mistakeText: Type what a student wrote. See the likely reason and what to ask.
home.practiceText: Problems with hints you open one at a time. No scores.

pages.inProgress: This page is still being built. The full lesson, worked examples and mistakes will appear here.

demo.title: Math handwriting components
demo.intro: Every math component, drawn from the plain-text steps the content packs store. Under each one is the text a screen reader speaks.
demo.fractionStepsLabel: Adding one half and one third
demo.rtlNote: The surrounding text runs right to left; the math stays left to right.
demo.inputIntro: The three ways to enter math: type it, write it, or take a photo. Below each input is exactly what the page receives. Written and photographed math is read by the server, and nothing is passed on until you confirm it.
demo.inputExpressionHint: Type fractions with a slash, like 2/5.

type.fallback: The math field didn’t load, so this is a plain text field. Type fractions with a slash, like 2/5.
type.tooLong: This is too long to check. Shorten it, or split it into lines.
type.emptyBox: Fill in the empty box first.

write.introOne: Write it with your finger, a pen or the mouse, on one line.
write.introLines: Write the working with your finger, a pen or the mouse, one step per line.

photo.intro: Take a photo of the student’s work, or upload one. You can crop and turn it next. It stays in this browser until it is read, and is never stored.
photo.cropHelp: Drag the box or its corners around the math. With the keyboard: arrow keys move the box, Shift with the arrow keys changes its size.
photo.cropState: The crop area is {w}% wide and {h}% tall, {x}% from the left and {y}% from the top.
photo.croppedAlt: The cropped photo that was read

review.heading: Is this what was written?
review.intro: Check each line. Edit anything that was misread. Nothing is checked until you confirm.
review.toCheck: {count, plural, one {# line needs a check.} other {# lines need a check.}}
review.unreadable: This line can’t be drawn as math. It will be sent as written.

blocked.none: There are no lines to use. Add one, or try again.
blocked.oneLine: Keep only one line here: remove the others.
blocked.tooMany: There are more than {max} lines. Remove some before you confirm.
blocked.tooLong: A line is too long to check (at most {chars} characters a side). Shorten it.

error.unclear: No math could be read here. Try again with clearer writing, or type it instead.
error.unavailable: Reading isn’t available right now. Type it instead, or try again later.
error.too_large: This image is too large to send. Crop it smaller, or type it instead.
error.bad_image: This image couldn’t be read. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo, or type it instead.
error.rate_limited: Too many requests just now. Try again in {seconds} seconds, or type it instead.
error.image: The image couldn’t be prepared. Try again, or type it instead.
error.open: This photo couldn’t be opened. Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP photo, or type it instead.
